chapter.verse: Amaute in lungkia loin thu a nget ngitnget nadingun, Zeisu in thugentehna tawh thu a hilh-inah,
“Khuapi khat sungah Pasian kihta lo, mi zahtak lo thukhen mangpa khat a om hi.
Tua khuapi sungah meigong khat a om hi. Amah in thukhen mangpa kiangah tamveipi pai-in, ‘Keima galte a kituak bekin thu hong khensak in,’ ci-in a ngen hi.
Ahih hangin thukhen mangpa in thu khensak loin sawtpi a om hi. Tua nung ciangin amah in, ‘Keimah in Pasian kihta loin mite ka zahtak loh hangin,
hih meigong in kei hong nainawn’sak man-inah ama ading thu ka khen ding hi. Ahih kei leh, hong pai ngitngetin ka lung hong gimsak ding hi,’ ci-in a lungsim sungah a ci hi,” ci-in a gen hi.
Topa in, “Aman lo thukhen mangpa’ thugenna na ngaihsun un.
Pasian’ teelsate in sun leh zanin ama kiangah kiko-in thu a nget uh leh, amaute’ thu khensak ding hilo ahi hiam? Amaute sawtpi thuak ding ahi hiam?
Ke’n kong cih-inah, amaute ading thu a khensak mengmeng ding hi. Ahih hangin Mihing Tapa hong kum ciangin leitungah upna a mu ding hiam?” a ci hi.
Amaute kidiksak a, midang khempeuh a zahtak lo mite kiangah, hih thugentehna Zeisu in a gen-inah,
“Mi nih in thu ngen dingin biakna innpi ah a paito uh hi. Khat in Farisai hi a, khat pen siahdongpa ahi hi.

Farisaipa ding-in amah leh amah kigen-in thungen a, ‘Pasian aw, keimah in mi zawhthawh bawla sut ahi zongin, mi thuman lo gamta ahi zongin, mi’ zi tawh mawh thei mi tham loin, hia siahdongpa tawh kibang ka hi kei hi. Nangma hehpihna ka phat hi.
Keimah in ni sagih lakah ni nih an ka tang hi. Ka neih ka lam khempeuh sung pan sehsawm suah sehkhat ka khia hi,’ ci-in kisialin thu a ngen hi.
Siahdongpa ahih leh, gamlapi-ah ding-in vantung lam nangawn en ngam loin a awm beengin, ‘Pasian aw, mawhnei keimah hong hehpih in,’ ci-in thu a ngen hi.

Ke’n kong cih-inah, hihpa in mawhmaisakna ngahin innah a ciah hi. Farisaipa in ahih leh, mawhmaisakna a ngah kei hi. Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, amah leh amah a kiphat mi khempeuh in niamkhiatna a ngah ding hi. A kiniamkhiatte in minphatna a ngah ding uh hi,’” a ci hi.
Tua lai takin amaute in naupangte a lawn’ nading deihin Zeisu kiangah hong paipih uh hi. Ahih hangin a nungzuite in a muh uh ciangin a kham uh hi.
Zeisu in naupangte sam a, “Naupangte ka kiangah hong pai ta hen; na kham kei un. Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, Pasian’ Gam in tua bangte’ gam ahi hi.
Ke’n aman takpi kong cih-inah, naupang bangin Pasian’ Gam a sang lo peuhmah in tua gam sungah a lut kei ding uh hi,” a ci hi.
Tua lai takin hausa khat in, “Sia pha aw, tawntung nuntakna ka luah nadingin bang ka gamta ding hiam?” ci-in a dong hi.
Zeisu in, “Bang hangin kei mipha hong ci na hi hiam? Pasian sim loh mipha khat beek a om kei hi.
Thukhamte na thei hi. Mi’zi tawh na mawh kei in. Mi na that kei in. Mi’ sum na gu kei in. Ahi lo teci na pang kei in. Na nu leh na pa zahtak in,” a ci hi.
“Tua thu khempeuh ka neu lai a kipan ka tang zo hi,” a ci hi.

Zeisu in tua a zak ciangin, “Na khat na sam lai hi. Na neihsa teng zuak in la, mizawngte kiangah na hawmsak in. Tua hi leh, vantungah sum na nei ding hi.Tua khit ciangin ka nung hong zui in,” a ci hi.
Hausapa in tua thu a zak ciangin, nakpi-in a lungkim kei hi. Bang hang hiam i cih leh, sum a hau hi.
Zeisu in tua pa a et lai takin, “Sum tam neite adingin Pasian’ Gam sung lut nading a haksa mahmah hi.
Sai khat phim vangah a khumhak sangin sumhau mite in Pasian’ Gam sungah lut nading a haksa zaw hi,” a ci hi.
Tua thu a zate in, “Tua bang ahih leh, gupna kua in ngah zo ding ahi hiam?” a ci uh hi.
Zeisu in, “Mihing in ahih zawh loh nate Pasian in ahih thei hi,” a ci hi.
Tua lai takin Piter in, “Kote in ka neih khempeuh uh nusia-in nangmah kong zui uh hi,” a cih ciangin,
Zeisu in, “Ke’n aman takpi kong cih-inah, Pasian’ Gam hangin a inn, a zi, a sanggamte, a nu a pa, a tate a nusia leh,
tu lai takin a zah tampi ngah a, a hong piang ding hunah tawntung nuntakna a ngah lo ding kuamah a om kei hi,” a ci hi.
Tua lai takin Zeisu in sawm-le-nihte sam a, “En un, eite Jerusalem khuapi ah i pai ding hi. Pasian’ kamsangte gelh kholhsa thu khempeuhte in Mihing Tapa tungah a tung ding hi.
Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, Gentailte khut tungah kipia ding a, zahkona, bawlsiatna leh cilphihna a thuak ding hi.
Amaute in amah satgawpin, a that ding uh hi. Ni thum ni ciangin a thokik ding hi,” a ci hi.
Amaute in hih thu khat beek a thei kei uh hi. Hih thu heem gen ahih ciangin a cihnopna a thei kei uh hi.
Zeisu in Jerikho khuapi a naih ciangin, mittaw khat in khutdawh ngenin lam geiah a tu hi.
Tua mittawpa in mi tampi lam pai a zak ciangin, “Kuate ahi hiam?” ci-in a dong hi.
Amaute in, “Nazareth mi Zeisu hong pai hi,” a ci uh hi.
“David’ Tapa, Zeisu aw, hong hehpih in,” ci-in a kiko hi.
A mai-a a pai mite in tua pa a tawp nadingin a taai uh hangin, “David’ Tapa aw, kei hong hehpih in,” ci-in a kiko sawnsawn hi.
Zeisu ding-in, “Tua pa hong paipih un,” a ci hi.
Mittawpa in a kiang a naih ciangin, “Nang ading bang ka bawl ding deih na hi hiam?” ci-in Zeisu in a dot ciangin, “Topa aw, ka mittang khua muh nading ka deih hi,” a ci hi.
Zeisu in, “Na mit in khua mu hen. Na upna in hong damsak zo hi,” a ci hi.
Amah in thakhatin khua mu thei a, Pasian’ min phatin Zeisu nung a zui hi. Mi khempeuhte in a muh uh ciangin Pasian a phat uh hi.
